cards.title: Descend to 2,500' and fly to Woodsboro
instructions: Exit through the transition layer, Area 5 Low, or a coordinated unoccupied area
Descend within the lateral confines of the KINGS 4 MOA to 2,500' MSL · 240 KIAS
Upon reaching 2,500' MSL, proceed direct to Woodsboro
Outside the MOA laterally above 2,500' MSL you must maintain flight following with ATC
cards.source: Binder, p. 12; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slides 73–74; Part 2, slide 34.
